name: hypotrail
description: A client of the Hypotrail CLI: it reads a Study through status --json, figures --json and profile --json and writes only through the CLI.

languageModelTools.name: hypotrail_read_study
languageModelTools.userDescription: Reads a Hypotrail Study of this workspace. The read writes nothing.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads one Hypotrail Study of this workspace and gives the object that `status --study=DIR --json` prints, whole: the Study, its write_sequence, its pending decisions with their questions and options, and its Decisions. It starts that read alone, which writes nothing. With one Study in the workspace, leave study out; with several, give study, the absolute path of the folder of one of them. When no single Study is found, the answer names the Studies found and nothing is read.

study.description: The absolute path of the folder of the Study to read. Needed only when the workspace holds several Studies.

languageModelTools.name: hypotrail_decide
languageModelTools.userDescription: Records one Decision in a Hypotrail Study through the CLI's `decide`, after you confirm it, unless you chose "Always Allow" for this tool.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Records one Decision in a Hypotrail Study of this workspace with the CLI command `decide`, once the user has confirmed it in VS Code, unless the user chose "Always Allow" for this tool. Give the question and the option as the Study's pending decision words them, cited_ids (the ids of the records the Decision cites, such as the Comparison's), read_sequence, the write_sequence of the Study as you last read it, and study, the absolute path of the folder of the Study to write to, even when the workspace holds one Study. author is human when the user stated the choice in chat, and proxy when you chose by a stated rule; with proxy, give source, which names that rule. When the user states the choice in this chat, pass words: the user's own messages that state it, each whole and as typed, one string per message, with author human; your own wording or a paraphrase goes in source, never in words. Words are recorded as relayed by you; the tool declares that channel itself, and an agent never declares the channel panel. Pass question_id and option_id, the ids of the pending decision's question and of the option chosen, as your read gives them; by is an optional label of who gave the words. The extension makes the request id. A write the CLI refuses, or that gets no answer, is reported and never sent again by this tool: read the Study before any other write.

question.description: The question of the pending decision, as the Study words it.

option.description: The option chosen, as the Study words it.

author.description: human when the user stated the choice; proxy when it was chosen by a stated rule.

cited_ids.description: The ids of the records the Decision cites.

source.description: What the Decision rests on. With author proxy it is required, and names the stated rule. With author human it may be given, and it is optional.

read_sequence.description: The write_sequence of the Study as last read.

words.description: The user's own messages that state the choice, each whole and as typed, one string per message. Only with author human. Recorded as relayed by Copilot and not checked against the chat.

question_id.description: The id of the pending decision's question, as the Study gives it. Given with option_id.

option_id.description: The id of the option chosen, as the Study gives it. Given with question_id.

by.description: An optional label of who gave the words, recorded as given. Only with words.

study.description: The absolute path of the folder of the Study to write to, as a read or a refusal of these tools lists it. Required, even when the workspace holds one Study.
